summary: Stripe payments integration tested end-to-end up to Stripe-hosted checkout. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass covering checkout session creation for all 4 product types (coin packages small_talk/popular, custom $20, premium_monthly, vip_monthly subscription), input validation (unknown package, below-min custom, no auth), and payment status endpoint (pending/404). Frontend: logged in as admin, navigated to /wallet, confirmed Top-up modal lists coin packages + custom amount, Premium dialog shows Premium-Lite/Premium/VIP cards. All 4 purchase buttons (coin package, custom $20, premium_monthly, vip_monthly) correctly POST /api/payments/checkout and redirect browser to a valid https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... URL. VIP Stripe page confirms subscription mode ('US$49.99 per month ... Subscribe'). Full card-payment completion on Stripe's SMP/Link-mode hosted page was not automated (Stripe's custom radio widget for payment-method selection does not expose standard inputs that Playwright can target reliably; this is Stripe UI, not the app). Fulfillment code path (_fulfill via /api/payments/status/{id} polling + webhook) is correct by code review.

issues: Non-blocking a11y warning in console: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (Radix UI dialogs). Minor accessibility improvement, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_checkout correctly handles managed_payments (SMP) with graceful fallback to Stripe Tax + billing_address_collection when ineligible. Subscription mode uses billing_address_collection=auto. Metadata carries user_id/package_id/type/coins — good for webhook fulfillment.
_fulfill is idempotent (checks fulfilled flag before granting coins/premium). Correct implementation.
payment_status endpoint also triggers _fulfill as a fallback if webhook does not reach preview — good resilience.
stripe_webhook signature verification uses STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET — correct.
server.py is 5073 lines (noted in prior iteration) — recommend splitting; not blocker.

seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one payment_transactions row per Stripe session (unfulfilled, pending). No cleanup needed; sessions expire on Stripe side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe is in test/sandbox mode (STRIPE_MODE=test, keys sk_test_*). Backend /api/payments/checkout works for 4 package_ids: coin ids (small_talk/starter/popular/extra/vip), 'custom' (with usd_amount>=1), 'premium_monthly', 'premium_lite_monthly', 'vip_monthly'. Response: {checkout_url, session_id}. Status: GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} - polls Stripe + fulfills on paid. Frontend wallet buy() in /app/frontend/src/pages/Wallet.jsx redirects via window.location.href. PaymentResult.jsx handles return. For e2e card payment automation, the Stripe SMP/Link hosted page requires clicking a custom 'Card' radio widget before #cardNumber appears — reliable automation needs waiting for the Link iframe/widget and may require clicking by coordinates or using Stripe's test session parameters. Alternatively, test fulfillment path directly by POSTing to Stripe test API or by mocking.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Stripe wiring is correct.
